needs.text: Express empathy and normalize feelings of job discomfort
needs.context: I am really sorry to hear that you are feeling this way, but please know that it is completely normal. Most people will experience a job where they feel uncomfortable, stuck, or unhappy at some point in their careers. Because "uncomfortable" can mean a lot of different things, the best approach is to break down your situation step-by-step. Here is a guide on what you should do next: ### 1. Identify the Root Cause Before you make any big decisions, you need to figure out exactly *why* you are uncomfortable. Grab a piece of paper and write down what is bothering you. Is it: *   **The Culture/Peo
